# PACT Vertical, LLC

> Development management, design management, and construction management for the commercial real estate industry. Based in Capitol Heights, Maryland, serving the Washington, DC, Maryland, and Virginia (DMV) region.

PACT stands for Partners, Advisors, Contractors, Technicians: "four assets in one." Founded in January 2021 by Dr. Gina Merritt, MBA (CEO), who has 25+ years of construction and construction management experience and 30+ years in real estate.

## Services

- Development Management: managing construction teams, architects, engineers, and property managers on mixed-income, mixed-use, and master-planned developments; working with local officials on permitting, planning board approvals, building permits, and land entitlements.
- Design Management: managing design and construction document development, contractor cost estimation, and value engineering to keep projects on budget.
- Construction Management: analyzing draws, walking the job during construction, and reviewing submittals, RFIs, ASIs, and change orders.

Skills: value engineering, construction budgeting and cost estimating, staffing, trade management, trade execution, supply chain delivery and logistics.

## Experience

- Affiliate Northern Real Estate Urban Ventures (NREUV) has provided construction and project management services for over $150M in DMV projects over 15 years.
- Three projects in Prince George's County, MD are in pre-development (managed by NREUV, with PACT Vertical as subcontractor or supplier).
- Selected projects from Dr. Merritt's career: John and Jill Ker Conway Residence (DC), Beacon Center (DC), Mayfair Mansions (DC), Crawford Square Apartments (Pittsburgh, PA), Wiley H. Bates Senior Housing (Annapolis, MD), A. Harry Moore HOPE VI (Jersey City, NJ), Carver Terrace (DC), TCCR Community Development Center (DC).
